summary.value: You tie your well-being to that of another.

system.description: You tie your well-being to that of another. Until this spell ends, if the target would be reduced to 0 HP, you may instead set their current HP equal to your own. If you do, you must immediately Surrender or Sacrifice yourself. If you are reduced to 0 HP by any other method, the target loses an amount of HP equal to your Crisis score.
